brief:
Palestinian families say their relatives are still detained in Israeli prisons despite serving their full sentences, Al Jazeera English reported. The families are waiting for reunions that have not materialized, adding to the anguish of prolonged separation.

The cases involve detainees held in Israeli custody beyond their sentence dates. Families have expressed frustration over the lack of release despite sentence completion.
dek: Palestinian families say their loved ones remain in Israeli prisons despite having completed their sentences.
title: Palestinians remain imprisoned after completing sentences, families say
